criteria.name: Functionality
criteria.description: Program correctly calculates statistics for student grades

levels.label: Complete
levels.description: Correctly calculates average, finds min/max, sorts grades

levels.label: Partial
levels.description: Some features work, others have significant bugs

criteria.name: Array Handling
criteria.description: Proper use of arrays and loops

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Efficient array operations, proper bounds checking, no hardcoded sizes

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Correct array usage with minor inefficiencies

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Array handling issues, potential out-of-bounds errors

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Correct sorting implementation (bubble, selection, or better)

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Sorting works but inefficient or incorrect edge cases

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Well-organized functions, clear comments, good naming

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Poor organization or lack of comments
